evidence_type: harness timings of the shared core's WAV export, base commit against the changed working tree, on one Windows laptop; plain-write timings on the same volume; local test-suite results
source_files_note: size_bytes and sha256 are of the bytes git stores for each blob, with LF line endings; the Windows working copies that were built had CRLF line endings from core.autocrlf
harness_build_command: cargo build --release --locked, from target/wav-export-bench of each checkout

harness_builds.harness_source_note: the harness before its optional pause argument was added; called without that argument, the published source runs the same code and adds pause_before_ms to each line

output_check_build.source: output-check-source.rs, built as src/bin/output-check.rs beside the paused-pass harness

harness_exe_note: the executables embed local build paths, so their hashes identify these builds only
limitations: One laptop with 32 logical processors, on AC power with the Turbo power scheme; CPU clocks, temperature, other running applications, the Windows file cache and SSD caching were not controlled.
Machines with fewer logical processors resample on fewer threads (one per lane with 2 or 3 logical processors) and were not measured.
Timed through the shared core's export function with a harness; no export was timed in the desktop app, the plug-in or a DAW, and no drag was timed.
macOS was not built or timed locally; the Swift app reaches the same core through export_routed_track_refs.
Only 32-bit float output was timed; 16- and 24-bit PCM share the resampler but were not timed.
A run ends when its files are closed; neither the exporter nor the harness flushes them to the device, and Windows may still be writing cached data after a run.
The C: volume had about 9.2 GB (about 0.9%) free during the runs, and Microsoft Defender real-time protection was on.
Synthetic noise was exported; the resampler's cost does not depend on the audio content.
The output check compares the two builds with each other on synthetic noise in 540 combinations; other lengths, offsets and content are covered only by the unit tests.
The first pass ran an earlier harness source, before its pause argument was added; harness_builds records the source hash each pass ran.
Built with rustc 1.95.0; CI builds with 1.99.1.
Raw test logs are not published; local-validation.json copies the counts from the cargo test summaries.
